title: OGC Simple Feature Access Part 1 Common Architecture 1.2.1
bounded_claim: Defines simple-feature geometry classes and association with a spatial reference system; supports separation of geometry identity from CRS and application semantics.
authority_limit: Does not define application workflow, analytical method, business authority, raster, trajectory or point-cloud semantics.

title: ISO 19111:2019 Geographic information — Referencing by coordinates
bounded_claim: Defines the conceptual schema and minimum information for coordinate reference systems, including time-dependent and moving-platform referencing cases.
authority_limit: Does not define feature identity, storage encoding, route analysis, workflow or publication authority.

title: OGC GeoTIFF Standard 1.1
bounded_claim: Defines requirements and encoding rules for georeferenced/geocoded imagery in TIFF and ties raster representation to geospatial reference metadata.
authority_limit: Encoding standard only; does not own raster analytical meaning, application workflow or observation truth.

title: OGC GeoPackage Encoding Standard 1.4.0
bounded_claim: Defines an interoperable SQLite container and integrity rules for vector features, tiles/raster maps, attributes and extensions.
authority_limit: Container/encoding authority only; does not collapse feature, raster, CRS or domain semantics into storage.

title: OGC API Moving Features Part 1 Core 1.0
bounded_claim: Defines access semantics for geospatial features whose location/attributes change over time and supports explicit spatiotemporal movement identity.
authority_limit: Does not define domain-specific trajectory interpretation, prediction, routing authority or physical control.
negative_twin: moving feature history != forecast != route decision

title: LAS Specification 1.4 OGC Community Standard
bounded_claim: Defines an open common format for LiDAR and other point-cloud records, including XYZ point data exchange.
authority_limit: Point-cloud representation authority only; does not define derived surfaces, classifications, inspection conclusions or physical reality.

title: Model Context Protocol specification 2026-07-28
bounded_claim: The 2026-07-28 MCP release makes the protocol core stateless, removes initialize/session coupling, adds explicit discovery and routing metadata, formalizes extensions and strengthens authorization semantics.
authority_limit: MCP specifies an agent/tool interaction protocol; it does not confer enterprise fact, policy, authorization, business-effect or acceptance authority on models or tools.

title: WASI adopted Component Model features through 0.3.1
bounded_claim: The WASI release ledger records 0.3.0 async lift/lower, future and stream and adopted 0.3.1 map<K,V>, implements and external-id features on 2026-08-06.
authority_limit: WASI defines component/runtime interface features; it does not define enterprise semantics, resource policy, authorization or provider qualification.
